current_milestone.title: Authorize and execute the controlled primary experiment
current_milestone.outcome: Both experiment packages and the executor are frozen; complete the second owner signoff, rotated-key confirmation, provider calibration, and formal execution without premature Final Test access.

commands.command: uv lock --check && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy --strict src scripts tests migrations && uv run pytest -q && uv run python scripts/validate_contracts.py && git diff --check && docker compose config --quiet
commands.summary: The updated full local gate passed: 69 locked packages, 115 formatted files, clean lint and strict typing across 71 source files, 150 tests, all contract/package checks, diff whitespace and Compose configuration.

commands.command: uv run pytest -q tests/application/test_formal_experiment.py tests/domain/test_contingency_benchmark.py tests/application/test_simulated_usability.py && env -u OPENAI_API_KEY -u RESEARCHFORGE_ROTATED_KEY_CONFIRMED uv run researchforge evolution-preflight
commands.summary: Formal, sealed-contingency, and simulation controls passed, including a 144-run synthetic full path. Real preflight contacted no provider, verified both frozen packages, truth hashes and budget bounds, and blocked only on owner signoff and rotated-key confirmation.

commands.summary: Five primary-package regressions passed. The contract validator accepted 24 sources, 144 facts, 24 explicitly synthetic chunks, 24 frozen cases, split isolation, cutoffs, references, artifact hashes and package hash stability.

commands.summary: Five success cases, five cutoff-driven missing-data cases and the fixed batch passed; 20/20 runs succeeded with four runs per mode and zero provider calls.

commands.summary: Frontend typecheck, lint, three unit tests, production build and Playwright E2E passed; axe found no critical-impact violations on Research or Skill Lab.

commands.command: docker compose build && docker compose up -d --wait && uv run python scripts/docker_smoke.py && docker compose exec -T api sh -c 'alembic downgrade base && alembic upgrade head'
commands.summary: The PostgreSQL/API/frontend stack built and became healthy; a frontend-proxied run persisted six facts and a ten-stage Trace, and migration down/up passed. Compatible Public ECR image overrides were used because Docker Hub authentication timed out.

commands.command: swift scripts/build_demo_video.swift && browser interaction over http://127.0.0.1:4173
commands.summary: Research and Skill Lab were visually and interactively verified with no console warnings/errors; two public-fixture PNGs and a 12-second 1280x720 H.264 preview were produced.
